That's a test/selector issue, not app defect. But wait, in the full run the error was "expected '<div.alert.alert-info.mb-4.d-none>' to be 'visible'". Exactly - the test selector is ambiguous/buggy. This is a pre-existing test bug, not an installation defect.

But there's also a static hidden alert-info always present. cy.get('.alert-info') returns all matches; .should('be.visible') asserts each? Actually in Cypress, `cy.get(selector).should('be.visible')` retries until the subject passes, but with multiple elements it checks... it can fail if the first is hidden. This is a known flakiness. Either way it's a test artifact.
